# countAllMissingByGroup

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `countAllMissingByGroup` is to count the number of missing values for all columns by a user-specified group. This function works across columns in a data frame or tibble and returns a summary table containing the missing observations for each column.

## Installation

You can install the development version of countAllMissingByGroup by calling:

``` r
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2YouminKim",ref="0.1.0")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which computes the number of missing values in the `airquality` dataset grouped by the `Month` column. 

```{r example}
library(countAllMissingByGroup)

# Find the number of missing observations within each month in the airquality part of datasets
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)

# An alternative way of invoking the `count_all_missing_by_group()`: piping the dataset into the function. 
airquality |> count_all_missing_by_group(Month) 
```
